nodes.label: GooseOS Favicon 16x16
nodes.description: A 16x16 pixel favicon depicting a small pixelated cartoon goose. The figure has a tan/brown body, a small beak, and simple limbs, rendered in the low-resolution style typical of browser favicons. Serves as the browser tab icon for the GooseOS Win95-style desktop environment.
nodes.visual_content: pixelated cartoon goose, brown/tan body, small beak, simple limbs
